profile.headline: Chief Systems Architect | Principal Embedded Linux & Edge AI Engineer | Senior Member, IEEE  | Pioneering Agentic AI (Harvard HDSI)
profile.jobTitle: Synergy Frame Link Module Embedded Linux Senior Systems/Software Engineer
profile.summary:
IEEE Senior Member with a 22+ year global R&D governance footprint bridging silicon-level microarchitecture, deterministic real-time environments, and cloud-to-edge AI systems infrastructure. 
Specialized in defining macro platform governance, hardware-software co-design, and deep-tech security architectures for mission-critical hyperscale computing, enterprise servers, and industrial automation networks.
Core Architecture Pillars:
• Deep-Tech Security & Compliance: NIST SP 800-193 (Hardware Root of Trust), Secure Boot Mechanics, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Migration, and Automated SBOM Generation.
• Silicon & Embedded Operating Systems: Senior Principal-level mastery of Embedded Linux (Yocto/BitBake, Rocky Linux, Debian), OpenBMC/XCC Stacks, and Redfish APIs.
• Deterministic RTOS & Network Protocols: Azure RTOS (ThreadX), VxWorks, FreeRTOS, zero-copy DMA streaming, and multi-processor communication fabrics.
• Enterprise Edge AI & MLOps: TinyML Architecture, LiteRT (TensorFlow Lite), and Harvard-backed Multi-Agent Orchestration frameworks (n8n/AGENT) designed to automate manual firmware compliance.
Collaborating strictly at the peer executive and C-suite technical level to transform complex hardware-firmware constraints into secure, unassailable, and scalable hybrid cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Synergy Frame Link Module Embedded Linux Senior Systems/Software Engineer
Senior Advisory BMC Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Role Scope: Served as a Senior Executive Advisor directing global firmware security roadmaps, supply chain governance, and automated release architectures for Tier-1 hyperscale enterprise environments.
    
●        Supply Chain Governance & Compliance Architecture: Architected and executed the comprehensive Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) strategic roadmap for next-generation XCC/BMC firmware stacks [Query-relevant Context]; enforced NIST-compliant supply chain security standards meeting stringent US Defense and Border Security criteria for Tier-1 hyperscale clients (including Amazon and Google).
  
●        Enterprise Pipeline & Efficiency Optimization: Engineered an automated, containerized CI/CD pipeline architecture that slashed global deployment lifecycles by 30% and reclaimed 360+ high-value engineering hours per enterprise project cycle.
  
●        Technical Advisory & Cross-Functional Mentorship: Led technical governance and inclusive engineering engagement programs for high-velocity teams; successfully maximized project delivery velocity while maintaining zero-defect firmware build and release standards.
  
●        Environment: Tech Stack Governance includes ASPEED ARM Processors, OpenBMC Stack, Redfish API, Yocto Linux (BitBake), Jenkins CI/CD, Docker, and Automated Scripting (PowerShell).

positions.title: Sr. Lead Embedded Firmware Security Engineer (BIOS/UEFI R&D)
positions.description:
•	Cost Reduction Innovation: Designed and implemented the first-ever industrial GUI/UI for EC Debug Boards, reducing servicing costs by 40% via factory-restore functionality for bricked units.
•	Agile Leadership: Managed a 'Power Team' of 4 engineers, utilizing PERT analysis to identify and eliminate roadmap impediments.
•	Award-Winning Mentorship: Won 'Best POC Award' for mentoring interns in converting cutting-edge technology into the upcoming notebook and workstation product lines.
•	Environment: ARM Cortex-M, ThreadX RTOS, Python, I2C, UART, SPI, PCIe, BLE.

positions.title: Principle Firmware Engineer (Research & Development Dept.)
positions.description:
•	Product Performance: Architected the next generation of top-selling scientific instruments (MicroHR, Duetta), achieving a 200% performance increase and 35% cost reduction.
•	Leadership: Provided technical mentorship and led teams using PERT/SWOT analysis for strategic alignment with organizational goals.
•	Environment: PIC32/24 (MIPS), LIN Bus, Xilinx Spartan FPGA, Secure Boot, C#, Qt.

positions.title: Senior Lead Embedded Firmware Security Engineer
positions.description:
•	Intel Technology Implementation: Led firmware analysis and testing for Intel's cutting-edge power management technologies (Modern Standby, S1-S4 Sleep).
•	Taiwan Collaboration: Partnered with Taiwan Development Center (TDC) and China (ODM) to eliminate roadblocks in commercial notebook and tablet releases.

positions.title: Vice President of Engineering
positions.description:
•	Strategic Oversight: Supported top management in process improvement, directly increasing productivity while staying within rigid budgets and goals.
•	Revenue Generation: Developed a customized Media Player (C++/VLC) that generated 28% more revenue per panel by securing media logs during communication failures.
•	Security Architecture: Implemented WPA2-PSK AES support with secure key generation (RSA, SHA-256) to meet strict network criteria for national fuel retailers (Kroger, HEB).

positions.title: Sr./Lead Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Secure Banking Infrastructure: Customized Embedded Linux on the i.mx287 (ARM926EJ) processor for next-gen secure mobile banking terminals, managing BSP, Kernel, and secure update mechanisms.
